title: Early Talent Pipeline - Shadow Sprint Notes (Jun 16 2026)
content:
Context:
This doc captures the week-long ‘shadow sprint’ we ran for early-talent candidates (interns/new-grads) as part of the platform-engineering pipeline. Goal: provide realistic exposure to production onboarding processes, evaluate pairing aptitude, and create a repeatable shadow-day template for future cohorts.

Attendees / participants:
- Interns / candidates: Zoe L., Marcus H., Jin S.
- Mentors: Aisha P. (owner), Diego R., Priya N.
- Observers / hiring: Evan B., Marta K.
- SRE liaison: Claire G. (prs and infra questions)

Sprint schedule (high-level):
- Day 0 (prep): environment checks, access provisioning, intro Slack channel, 1:1 with mentor
- Days 1-4: paired work blocks (3 hours pairing, 1 hour independent), daily standup at 10:15, end-of-day 1:1 feedback
- Day 5: readout + hiring debrief + candidate self-reflection

Summary notes by day:
Day 1 (Jun 16):
- Focus: repo walkthrough, local dev environment, small bug fix in metrics collector.
- Pairing log: Zoe + Diego, 2.5h. Observed: good clarifying questions, struggled with repo layout but recovered quickly.
- Action: create a one-pager "platform repo map" for interns (owner: Aisha, due: Jun 23).

Day 2 (Jun 17):
- Focus: tracing and a simple observability dashboard change (console telemetry).
- Pairing log: Marcus + Priya, 3h. Observed: Marcus comfortable with SQL-ish queries, hesitant on test stubs.
- Note: needed short primer on mocking external services. Add to onboarding checklist.

Day 3 (Jun 18):
- Focus: small infra task — adjust autoscaler config in staging (no production access).
- Pairing log: Jin + Diego, 3h. Observed: Jin asked good questions about safety checks and rollout policy.
- Incident: flaky test in CI surfaced (flaky-kv-cache-test). Took ~1h to triage; left a debugging checklist item (owner: Claire, due: Jun 20).

Day 4 (Jun 19):
- Focus: documentation + code review practice. Interns wrote PRs for earlier tasks.
- Pairing: cross-review (Zoe reviews Marcus, Marcus reviews Jin). Observed: thoughtful comments, need guidance on comment tone and constructive feedback.
- Action: update PR review playbook short doc (owner: Priya, due: Jun 24).

Day 5 (Jun 20):
- Readouts + hiring panel. Each intern presented 8-minute summary + 4-minute Q&A.
- Panel feedback collected and consolidated (below).

Assessment snapshots (ramp readiness & soft skills):
- Zoe L.: Technical baseline strong for internship; good triage instincts; recommend conversion to intern with extra guidance on large repo navigation. Score: 7/10 (owner: Diego).
- Marcus H.: Strong analytical thinking, needs test/mocks practice; recommendation: convert -> project-based internship (focus on observability). Score: 6.5/10 (owner: Priya).
- Jin S.: Clear safety-minded approach, good infra instincts; recommend conversion with SRE shadow rotation. Score: 7.5/10 (owner: Aisha).

Hiring panel notes (high level):
- What to look for long-term: curiosity about "why" code exists, ownership language, comfort asking for help.
- Red flags: defensive responses to feedback, confusion about basic git workflows even after pairing.

Operational learnings (what changed / what to keep):
- Pairing window timing: 3h blocks hit a sweet spot — long enough to finish microtasks, short enough to keep energy high. Keep for next cohort.
- Prebuilt local env: still too brittle. Invest 1 sprint to containerize staging dev env (owner: platform infra team, request sent: ENG-11234).
- Pairing rotation template: successful when mentors switch midweek to expose candidates to different approaches. Keep but limit to max 2 mentor switches.
- CI flakiness disrupted flow. Need weekly flaky-test audit from SRE (owner: Claire).

Action items (owners + due dates):
- Create "platform repo map" one-pager for interns — Aisha — due 2026-06-23
- Add mocking/external-service primer to onboarding checklist — Priya — due 2026-06-22
- Debugging checklist for flaky-kv-cache-test — Claire — due 2026-06-20
- PR review micro-playbook (tone + checklist) — Priya — due 2026-06-24
- Containerized local staging dev env proposal — ENG infra (ticket ENG-11234) — proposal by 2026-07-02

Unresolved / follow-ups:
- Access scope: interns still request an intermediate "staging-plus" environment rather than full staging. Need policy decision: what subset of staging tools to expose? (Owner: Security & Compliance; contact: Marta K.)
- Conversion criteria: formalize a 4-week evaluation rubric for conversions from shadow -> paid internship. Draft needed (owner: Evan B.).

Candidate quotes / self-reflection highlights (verbatim snippets):
- "Pairing felt real — I liked being asked to explain my thinking out loud." — Marcus
- "CI flakiness made it hard to trust test results; it was valuable to see how the team debugs it." — Zoe
- "I hadn't thought about rollout policies in depth before — seeing the autoscaler config opened my eyes." — Jin

Template suggestions for next runs:
- Pre-read packet (1 pager): repo map, quick git cheatsheet (branching/PR flow), dev env checklist.
- 2 mentor rotation max, standard pairing block 3h, daily standup 15m at 10:15, end-of-day 1:1s 20m.
- Centralized feedback form (Google Form) for interns with quantitative + open text fields (owner: People Ops / early-talent).

Misc notes / links referenced during the week:
- Onboarding checklist (working copy): confluence:EARLY-TALENT-2026/onboarding-checklist
- CI flaky test backlog: JIRA:ENG-11090
- PR used for learning example: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/412

Next steps (this doc):
- Share with hiring committee (Evan, Marta, People Ops) by 2026-06-21.
- Convert actions into Jira tickets and track in ENG-11234 epic.

Quick status summary for weekly engineering update email (to send Fri 2026-06-18):
- Ran first shadow-sprint for early talent (3 candidates). Panel recommends moving 2 -> internship offers pending rubric finalization. Several infra/onboarding improvements surfaced; owners assigned.

Notes to self (Aisha):
- Capture one small 'wins' deck slide per intern for hiring packet.
- Follow up with Claire about flaky tests before next cohort.
- Schedule conversion rubric sync with Evan next week.

End of doc.
